25/S0.subgoal: Introduce the topic of Human Factors and its relevance to Extended Reality systems.

25/S1.subgoal: Describe the components of an XR system and the importance of interaction and perceptual design.

25/S2.subgoal: Explain why human perception must be understood to build effective XR systems.

25/S3.subgoal: Define perceptual psychology and list the relevant questions it helps address in XR.

25/S4.subgoal: Classify the human senses, their associated organs, and their types of stimuli.

25/S5.subgoal: Describe how sensory system selectivity and different receptors enable the process of perception.

25/S6.subgoal: Summarize the physiological basis of human senses and outline subsequent lecture topics.
